nodes.name: 0000_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Initial Drizzle ORM schema snapshot (migration 0000_needy_jackal, prevId all-zero) capturing the baseline Postgres schema: Better Auth tables (user, session, account, verification) plus the core platform tables (requests, request_messages, quotes, invoices, subscriptions, plans, quotas, notifications, activity_log, attachments, app_settings, contact_leads, demo_runs).
nodes.languageNotes: Drizzle-kit generated snapshot JSON, not hand-authored; diffed against the previous snapshot (by `id`/`prevId`) to produce each SQL migration file.

nodes.name: 0001_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Second Drizzle schema snapshot (migration 0001_modern_darwin) adding the demos data model: demos, demo_access, and demo_secrets tables backing owner-authored, per-customer product demos.

nodes.name: 0002_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Third Drizzle schema snapshot (migration 0002_nifty_maddog) refining column/constraint definitions across the existing platform tables introduced in 0000/0001, with the same table set as 0001.

nodes.name: 0003_snapshot.json
nodes.summary: Fourth Drizzle schema snapshot (migration 0003_sour_infant_terrible) adding site_content and site_solutions tables that back the /admin/site owner-editable content model (hero, footer, homepage sections, per-solution copy and media).

nodes.name: _journal.json
nodes.summary: Drizzle migration journal (postgresql dialect, format version 7) listing the four applied migrations in order — 0000_needy_jackal, 0001_modern_darwin, 0002_nifty_maddog, 0003_sour_infant_terrible — each with its applied timestamp, used by drizzle-kit to track migration history.
